_metadata.description: Procedural scene generation and composition scaffolds. Owns the code that draws base imagery and the conditioning images that steer model-backed generation.

requirements.title: The system shall produce byte-identical procedural output for identical inputs
requirements.description: While a style declares a strategy of `procedural` or `procedural-treated`, the system shall produce byte-identical output for the same style version, seed, and resolved palette. The system shall draw from a seeded pseudo-random source and shall not read wall-clock time or an unseeded random source during scene generation.

validation.notes: Render each seeded scene generator twice and compare checksums. A static check asserts no unseeded random or clock read inside the scaffold package.

requirements.title: The system shall render a scaffold preset into a conditioning image
requirements.description: Where a style declares the `guided` strategy, the system shall render its scaffold preset into a conditioning image in the form its declared conditioner requires — a depth field for a depth conditioner, an edge drawing for an edge conditioner — and shall submit that image as the conditioning input on the generation request.

validation.notes: For each preset, assert both conditioner forms render, and that the composed plan carries the conditioning image reference.

requirements.title: The system shall draw each reserved region into the scaffold as a featureless area
requirements.description: The system shall render each of the style's reserved regions into the conditioning image as a flat, featureless area, so that the quiet zone is expressed to the model as structure rather than left to chance. This is the mechanism by which a guided render arrives already close to passing the legibility gate.

validation.notes: Assert the conditioning image's variance inside every reserved rectangle is below a declared flatness threshold for every preset.

requirements.title: The system shall expose scaffold presets as parameterised records rather than fixed drawings
requirements.description: The system shall express each scaffold preset as a named record with declared parameters — at minimum horizon height, focal position, and focal scale — so that one preset serves many compositions and a style records which parameter values it used.

validation.notes: Assert each preset declares its parameter set and that two distinct parameter values yield distinct conditioning images.
